knownLimitations: Calculator is arithmetic-only (no units/currency reasoning) — totals are checked, unit mismatches are not.
Injection filter is a line-level heuristic; a paraphrased instruction that avoids the known patterns can pass into extraction fields.
The review checks are deterministic heuristics, not a second model — correlated errors they share with the writer are still possible.
